name: holmes_far_travel
title: How the original moves an actor that heads for the player from outside the loaded area (owner 2026-10-24: it looks like a jump closer every minute, not a walk). The first star cap's OnAdd script (NVStarBottleCapScript) moves Malcolm Holmes to SSHQMalcolmHolmesMarker (35732, -12347, east of Novac), enables him and evaluates his packages; SSHQMalcolmHolmesTalkToPlayerPackage (Dialogue, Always Run, target the player, while the player is in WastelandNV and VFreeformSSHQ.talkedtomalcolm is 0) takes him to the player. He is tracked wherever he is, every 60 game loops; the player stands still (god mode) at a map marker. Each session needs its own run (--only), as the script only moves him once (VFreeformSSHQ.firstcap). Sessions: near (Novac, 24k units), mid (188 Trading Post, 45k), far (Goodsprings Cemetery, 101k). The moving-player case is holmes_far_moving.campaign.json (two sessions in one game load: plugin v7 has no timed actions). No quest-variable header fields: `VFreeformSSHQ.firstcap` does not compile in a header script and broke the whole header [observed 2026-10-24].
